evals.prompt: Review my branch against origin/main before I open a PR. It changes TypeScript code, tests, and README documentation.
evals.expected_output: A scoped review that checks the actual diff, documentation quality, project checks, security, and test coverage without inventing frontend results.

evals.prompt: Do a pre-PR review of this branch. It updates a Vue form, its styles, and a client-side API call.
evals.expected_output: A review that routes markup through the HTML skill, uses the web quality audit proportionately, checks accessibility and browser behaviour, and performs the all-change security pass.

evals.prompt: Check this branch before PR: it contains a database migration, CI workflow, dependency manifest, and lockfile update.
evals.expected_output: A review that highlights migration safety, CI permissions and secret exposure, dependency relevance, and safe verification limits.
